author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Resonator Lucilla Trailer for Wuthering Waves, an action open-world game developed by Kuro Game. Players can get a stylish look at Lucilla in action, fitted with her flashy attacks, with her trusty camera in hand. Lucilla is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, iOS, Android, and PC.
title: Wuthering Waves - Official Resonator Showcase: Lucilla Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Release Window Trailer for Bomb the Hill, a cinematic VR downhill skateboarding game developed by Poko Dzima VR Studio. Players will race down dangerous mountain roads, weave through traffic at insane speeds, battle desperate rivals, perform tricks, and survive brutal crashes. The game blends realistic downhill mechanics with atmospheric storytelling and a road-trip vibe. Bomb the Hill is launching in Summer 2026 for Meta Quest and Steam VR.
title: Bomb The Hill - Official Release Window Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Early Access Trailer for Jetpack Clankers, a multiplayer, high-octane jetpack game developed by Wooorld. Players will customize their clanker and race through massive arenas at extreme speeds, boost around hairpin turns, and thread tight gaps. Need a breather? We have tons of other things to do! Try Clankball, shooting, arcade games, toys or make beats with your friends. Jetpack Clankers is launching into Early Access on June 16.
title: Jetpack Clankers - Official Early Access Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Announcement Trailer for Poly Truck, a poly-based simulation driving game developed by SoloDive Interactive. Players can step inside a highly interactive low-poly cockpit where every key turn, gear shift, and cabin control responds directly to your virtual hands. Master the realistic weight of your rig, navigate dynamic traffic, and conquer challenging routes across a stylized world. Poly Truck is coming soon to Meta Quest.
title: Poly Truck - Official Announcement Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Launch Trailer for Voxel Playground, a physics-driven voxel sandbox game developed by Cydream. Players will unleash even more creativity on PC with a brand-new map, new items, and new mods. Build, experiment, and explore endless possibilities in this voxel-based sandbox playground. Voxel Playground is available now on Meta Quest and SteamVR.
title: Voxel Playground - Official Launch Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Release Window Trailer for Already Dead, a classic 90's survival horror game developed by Mooncall Games. Players will solve riddles, make use of items found across the environment, and seek hidden areas through exploration. Already Dead is launching in Fall 2026 for PlayStation VR2 (PS VR2).
title: Already Dead - Official Release Window Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Release Window Trailer for Hyperlane Highway, a VR hoverboard roguelite developed by Ryality Studio. Players will lean their whole body to steer through neon hyperlanes, dual wielding blasters with independent aim in each hand. Dodge escalating enemy fire, build a loadout from a deep pool of roguelite upgrades, and push deeper every run. Hyperlane Highway is coming soon to Q4 2026 for Meta Quest.
title: Hyperlane Highway - Official Release Window Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Gameplay Trailer for Rustmourne, an upcoming sci-fi horror VR survival game. Players will traverse the corridors of an ancient, derelict structure, and face the tortured beings in it: hide, run, or cut off their limbs to survive. Rustmourne is coming soon to SteamVR.
title: Rustmourne - Official Gameplay Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Everybody! Everybody! Check out the latest Walkabout Mini Golf trailer to see what to expect with the Homestar Runner Distraction Pack, aka the ultimate takeover of Walkabout Mini Golf by Strong Bad and friends, complete with designs and in-game character experiences by The Brothers Chaps. Experience the greatest turducken of unique cosmetics, never-before-seen mini-games, and iconic Homestar Runner locations/bits ever seen. Grab some couch, get a whiff of the rubber handle on the putters that a thousand people have touched, and get distracted! 

The Homestar Runner Distraction Pack for Walkabout Mini Golf will be available on Meta Quest, SteamVR, and PlayStationVR2 on June 25, 2026.
title: Walkabout Mini Golf - Official Homestar Runner Distraction Pack Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Game Night is the absurd mixed-reality party game where YOU are the controller! Watch the latest Game Night trailer to see what to expect with the co-op update, which includes new co-op tournament scores, leaderboards, and rewards. With the co-op update, there's no mode selection, and you can just play the way you want to play. A new cosmetics system has also been added, where you can dress each other and also change your player color. Game Night is available in Early Access, with the version 1.0 release coming in 2026. The co-op update is available today, June 12, 2026.
title: Game Night - Official Co-op Update Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at gameplay and what you can expect from Hauntify Multiplayer, a new mixed reality horror experience that lets players invite friends into their scanned real-world house, whether they are playing co-located in the same space or joining from around the world in VR. One player can explore their physical environment in mixed reality while other players enter that same scanned space as allies, enemies, or monsters. The game expands Hauntify’s house-transforming horror gameplay with multiplayer, sandbox play, AI-controlled threats, and player-controlled monster modes. Hauntify Multiplayer is coming soon and is designed to push mixed reality beyond a single-player experience. Hauntify Multiplayer will be available in 2027.
title: Hauntify Multiplayer - Official Gameplay Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Color-A-Cube leaves Early Access and version 1.0 will be available on Meta Quest and Pico on June 18, 2026. Watch the latest Color-A-Cube trailer for another look at this cozy VR color-by-numbers game which combines voxel art, crisp interactions, satisfying pops, and sparkling completion effects into a relaxing, creative experience. Version 1.0 features over 100 voxel models, new story-driven coloring experiences, weekly free model drops, monthly DLC releases, and crossover content with other games.
title: Color-A-Cube - Official Version 1.0 Release Date Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Reveal Trailer for Project NEOS, an original sci-fi escape survival game developed by False Horizon. Players will escape from a space station that's entirely governed and controlled by an AI system You'll need to use your wits, cunning, and instincts in order to survive. Project NEOS is coming soon with an alpha playtest available now.
title: Project NEOS - Official Reveal Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Launch Trailer for Sugar Madness, a VR fast-paced, immersive first-person shooter developed by JollyCo Inc. Players will wield a vast arsenal of mind-blowing weapons, varied enemies, and mighty bosses. Take on the single-player campaign or co-op mode in Sugar Madness, available now for Meta Quest.
title: Sugar Madness - Official Launch Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Chapter 2 Announcement Trailer for The Obsessive Shadow, a VR survival horror exploration game developed by Pablo Heckman. Players will soon gain access to Chapter 2, filled with new challenges, threats, and frights to endure. Chapter 2 of The Obsessive Shadow is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), PlayStation VR2 (PS VR2), Meta Quest, and SteamVR.
title: The Obsessive Shadow - Official Chapter 2 Announcement Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: BrushHammer is a mixed-reality game that lets you live the miniature painting hobby without spilling paint on your desk! Check out the Brushammer: Miniature Painter trailer to see gameplay from this upcoming game. Pick from a huge collection of minis, kitbash them with different parts and accessories, and paint them using awesome tools like spray cans, airbrushes, shading brushes, decals, and shiny coatings. Show off your masterpiece in your space, send pics to friends, and climb from total newbie to legendary painter in Career Mode. Complete commissions, impress picky judges, and spend your hard-earned points in the hobby shop on new tools, accessories, and upgrades for your creative setup. BrushHammer Miniature Painter will be available on Meta Quest.
title: BrushHammer: Miniature Painter - Official Gameplay Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at gameplay and the game modes of Flyon RC in this trailer for the upcoming miniature flying game for VR and Mixed Reality. Fly drones, RC planes and other aircrafts through your home or handcrafted VR arenas, master skill-based challenges and have fun with friends. Become a pilot without leaving your room. Flyon RC will be available on Meta Quest in summer 2026.
title: Flyon RC - Official Gameplay Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Theremin transforms your Meta Quest headset into a fully playable mixed reality theremin, bringing expressive gesture-based music performance into your home. Watch the Theremin trailer to see what's coming with the Ghost Hands add-on, which allows players to record motion loops and perform in ensemble with cloned versions of themselves. Layer melodies, harmonies, and textures to become your own ethereal chamber orchestra. Theremin is available now on Meta Quest. The Ghost Hands add-on launches on July 1, 2026.
title: Theremin - Official Ghost Hands Add-On Announce Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at Cards of Destiny for a look at this VR tabletop strategy game where your hands control fate itself, using magical one-use cards to save, protect, curse, or sacrifice tiny beings living on your board. Build your deck, shape the battlefield, and survive chaotic challenges where every card can change someone’s destiny. Developed by United Games, Cards of Destiny brings a playful god-game fantasy to VR with hand-driven interactions, strategic choices, and miniature worlds full of big consequences. Cards of Destiny will be available in Early Access on Meta Quest and SteamVR on August 28, 2026.
title: Cards of Destiny - Official Early Access Release Date Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at gameplay from Disembodied in this trailer for the upcoming mixed reality platformer that turns your real hand movements into precise, physics-driven gameplay, taking hand tracking to a whole new level. Disembodied will be available on Quest 3 and Quest 3s on October 15, 2026.
title: Disembodied - Official Release Date Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Get another look at Puzzles of the World in this trailer for the upcoming virtual reality game that combines the relaxing nature of building miniature wooden puzzles, with beautiful environments from around the world and beyond. The full release of Puzzles of the World will be available on Meta Quest on July 23, 2026.
title: Puzzles of the World - Official Pre-Order Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the latest Lanesplit trailer for this sports arcade racing game to see what's coming with the VR update, including a new manufacturer, new characters, and SteamVR support. Successfully slip through traffic in VR and avoid disastrous collisions to rack up points from a whole new perspective in Lanesplit. Redline all-new electric motorcycles with elite acceleration and top speed, navigate inclement weather with the addition of thunderstorms, and enjoy appearances from real-world motorcycle influencers. Lanesplit's VR update will be available on Steam on June 23, 2026.
title: Lanesplit - Official VR Update Release Date Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Step into a thrilling narrative investigation in Virtual Reality. Check out gameplay and more from Detective VR in this latest trailer for the upcoming game. In Detective VR, you control time, collect crucial clues, and interview witnesses to unravel the plot. Detective VR will be available on PS VR2 and SteamVR on September 9, 2026.
title: Detective VR - Official Release Date Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Meet the classes of Heroes Together VR in this latest trailer for the upcoming multiplayer dungeon crawler where every run shows you more and more of the world. Master four distinct combat styles and discover countless secrets. Play as the Knight, Archer, Brawler, or newly announced Mage When Heroes Together VR launches into Early Access on Quest 3 in September 2026.
title: Heroes Together VR - Official Classes Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a fresh look at Pedal Rebel VR in this story reveal trailer, along with an early access release date announcement. Pedal Rebel VR is a cyberpunk street racing game that you can play on a real exercise bike and turn your whole body into the controller. Lean and Pedal to go fast, dodge traffic, and see if you've got what it takes to join the rebellion. Pedal Rebel VR will be available in Early Access on Meta Quest and SteamVR on October 5, 2026.
title: Pedal Rebel VR - Official Story & Early Access Release Date Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: From the creators of Guardians Frontline, Guardians Planetfall drops you into a galaxy-wide war for the fate of humanity. Check out the Guardians Planetfall trailer to see gameplay and more from this upcoming FPS VR game. In Guardians Planetfall, fight assembled into squads of up to 4 soldiers in fast, tactical VR combat across dangerous procedural planets and space installations filled with hostile Aliens, Void soldiers, and massive war machines. Guardinas Planetfall will be available in early access in 2026 on Meta Quest and SteamVR.
title: Guardians Planetfall - Official Early Access Release Window Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Get another look at Bootstrap Island in this latest trailer for this upcoming Robinson Crusoe–inspired VR roguelike survival adventure set in the 17th century. The first major update for Bootstrap Island since its full release in March 2026 brings new content and features, including a cumulative progression system, a redesigned inventory, new nighttime dangers, and numerous gameplay improvements. Shipwrecked on a ruthless tropical island, you must survive without guidance in Bootstrap Island. Trust your instincts as you face wild beasts, nature’s fury, and a mysterious local tribe. Bootstrap Island's update 1.1.0 is live now on SteamVR.
title: Bootstrap Island - Official Update Launch Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the trailer for Board of the Future for a look at this upcoming VR racing sim action game. Board of the Future features the coolest and fastest piece of alien technology from the future. Cruise leisurely over rolling hills and pull off some cool tricks. Or upgrade your board into an extremely fast beast and pull off the sickest moves. Board of the Future features single player and online multiplayer coop and unlockable boards with different characteristics. Perform physics-based tricks by moving your hands and a momentum-based hill-jumping and landing mechanic you´ve loved in other games (Haste, Tiny Wings). Board of the Future will be available on Quest and SteamVR in 2026.
title: Board of the Future - Official Announce Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Salmon Man gets a multiplayer update. Watch the Salmon Man trailer to see what to expect with multiplayer gameplay for the physics-based VR platformer game, where you climb upstream using nothing but your paddle. The Multiplayer update arrives in July 2026, bringing the ability to compete with friends as you fight your way to the top. Unlock new paddles and achievements, conquer the all-new extreme Lava Mode, and explore a brand-new mountain map. Grab a friend, start climbing, and see who reaches the top first! The Multiplayer mode for Salmon Man will be available in July 2026 on Meta and Steam.
title: Salmon Man - Official Multiplayer Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the tense trailer for C.A.B.A. (Center of Anomalies of Buenos Aires), a short first-person survival horror game. Set in a Buenos Aires subway station that shouldn't exist, the game is our take on the Backrooms metro level, a subterranean liminal space rarely explored in video games. You can't fight what walks the tunnels down here; you can only try to escape. C.A.B.A. will be launching with full VR support on PS VR2, Meta Quest, and SteamVR, plus flat versions for PS5 and Steam.
title: C.A.B.A. - Official Announce Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2026
